# Shift handover: farm-life-chats (personal assistant chats, May 20–29 2023) · 2026-11-12 03:18 UTC
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (no args).
> Nature of the work: NOT a code project. The repo (`1f4659e start`, only `.claude/` + `.gitignore`) holds nothing from these chats. The "session" is a series of dated personal chats (2023-05-20 → 2023-05-29). What matters is who the user is, what they told me, and what I told them — including my own mistakes.

## 0 · Read these first
None. No files were created or edited for the user's tasks. Everything is in this handover.

## 1 · Status
🟡 Ten unrelated chat threads. All answered, but two are left unfinished (Midjourney reply cut off mid-command; Flagstaff/Kaneohe essay cut off mid-sentence), and several earlier answers of mine contain errors (see §6) that should be corrected if the topic comes back.

## 2 · Picture
The user chats about everyday life: a small farm (chickens + goats, egg sales, budgeting), music/concerts and an LA trip, cooking (Cherokee heritage dishes, healthy brunch/meal prep), cleaning chores, creative-prompt tasks (KDP prompt, Midjourney), a heart-symptom question, and a college essay. There is no single goal; expect follow-up questions that rely on details below (numbers, names, dates, order of events).

## 3 · Next actions
1. If the user returns to the **essay** (2023-05-29): finish it. Spec [user said]: act as a first-year college student; 1000–1250 words; two topics = the user's own experiences/observations living in **Flagstaff, AZ** and **Kaneohe, HI**; ≥3 points of analysis; quotes from **two** sources; **four** MLA in-text citations; descriptive language; personal anecdotes; Works Cited at end. My draft stopped mid-sentence at "According to a local newspaper, 'Hawaii is one of the most" and used **invented sources** ("Flagstaff Daily Times, 2021", "Flagstaff Gazette, 2021", "Kaneohe Gazette, 2022") with non-MLA (Name, year) citations and no Works Cited. Done when: full essay, real/verifiable sources (or clearly marked placeholders), MLA (Author page) format, Works Cited present. Also my draft invented user details (warm-climate origin, ethnic background, moved to Kaneohe "for the summer") — ask/flag rather than invent.
2. If the user returns to **Midjourney** (2023-05-25): redo in their exact format — 3 `/prefer option set option:<one-word name>` suffixes named **aerial**, **kingdom**, **natural** (I wrongly used `futuristic-shaman-aerial` etc.), each preceded by persuasive ad copy, then **5** `/imagine prompt:[Scene] with [Traits], [Lighting], [Mood]. --[aerial|kingdom|natural] --ar 16:9` in code blocks (wallpapers). My reply was truncated at command 4 of 5 and mixed formats.
3. If the farm budget comes up: correct my errors in §6 proactively.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Don't | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Invent essay sources / quotes | My draft fabricated newspapers; an MLA essay needs citable sources | user supplies sources or allows placeholders |
| Rename the Midjourney options | User asked for `--aerial`, `--kingdom`, `--natural` | user renames |
| Diagnose the heart question | Not medical advice; recommend a clinician | — |
| Claim to have visited places / personal experience | I'm an AI (told user so on 05-20) | — |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** [user said unless noted] (user's gender/pronouns never stated — use they/them):
- Has a **boyfriend, Alex**. Went with him to a **Red Hot Chili Peppers concert at the Hollywood Bowl**, "just got back" as of 2023-05-20. Also saw **Billie Eilish** in concert recently, **before** RHCP (user ordered the playlist chronologically: Billie Eilish first, then RHCP). Huge rock-concert fan.
- Planning a **trip to LA** (as of 05-20); thinking of buying new music gear. (I called Alex "your guitar-playing boyfriend" — the user never said he plays guitar [assumed, my error].)
- Road-trip playlist of concert artists; will add **Lana Del Rey** and **Foo Fighters**, maybe **The 1975** (heard their live shows are great).
- Has always wanted to **visit the Great Wall of China**; interested in architecture (05-20).
- Runs a **small farm**: chickens and goats.
  - Hens/rooster: **Luna** (a Leghorn hen, "doing great"); **Boris** the rooster (got $100 antibiotics "last month" = ~April 2023, said 05-22).
  - Goats: **Billy** and **Nanny**. Nanny has a **limp**; user may take her to the vet (05-22). Training both to walk on a leash, using treats/positive reinforcement — "seems to be working" (05-26). Uses their milk to experiment with **cheese and yogurt** ("decent results"); considering selling goat-milk products.
  - Eggs: sold **40 dozen so far this month** (said 2023-05-22, i.e. May 2023). Sells to a **neighbor at $3/dozen** (05-26) → 40 dozen ≈ **$120**.
  - Expenses (May 2023): fencing around chicken coop replaced **$200**; chicken feed **$150**; goat feed **$250**; vet: Boris antibiotics **$100** (April).
  - Making **own chicken feed from grains bought from a local farm** to cut costs.
  - Considering more chickens; interested in Leghorns and **Rhode Island Reds**. Plans a farm social media account/blog.
- **Cherokee heritage**: attending a **Cherokee cultural festival "next month"** (said 2023-05-23 → June 2023). Wants to cook Three Sisters Soup and Wild Onion & Wild Garlic Fritters beforehand.
- Daily **10-minute morning meditation**; wants quick healthy breakfasts after it. **Tired of avocado toast.**
- Woke around **9:30 am on Saturday** (2023-05-20; said 05-25), later than usual.
- **Meal preps on Sundays**; plans **Quinoa and Black Bean Salad** with the **Classic Tahini Sauce** on Sunday 2023-05-28.
- Cleaning this weekend (May 27–28, 2023), incl. **scheduling a carpet cleaning for the living room** (mentioned twice on 05-25). Wants a laundry detergent that leaves **no residue**.
- Asked about shortness of breath with a heart condition, framed as "my heart" and frustrated (05-28) — possibly has a heart condition [assumed]; be gentle.
- Has lived in **Flagstaff, AZ** and **Kaneohe, HI** (essay topic, 05-29).

**Taste**
| I assumed | User corrected / signalled | Rule | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| KDP prompt: assistant gives no book content | Wanted content creation included | Final KDP prompt covers every aspect incl. content | "You should also provide content for the books, you will assist in every aspect" |
| — | Prompt-generator task | Output the prompt only, no preamble | "(Give me prompt only)" |
| Loose interpretation of specs | User gives exact formats (Midjourney, essay) | Follow given formats/counts literally (names, number of items, code blocks, word counts) | "Please put each command into code blocks" |

## 6 · Evidence ledger — errors in my earlier answers (correct if raised)
| Claim I made | Status | Correct |
|---|---|---|
| Fencing $200 depreciated over 5 yrs = **$40/month** | WRONG | $200 ÷ 60 months ≈ **$3.33/month** ($40 is per year) |
| Fencing is a fixed expense? I reclassified it as **capital** | my call | user had wanted it under fixed expenses; fine to keep as capital but explain |
| Total variable expenses **$675** after adding Boris | WRONG arithmetic | 150+250+100−75+100 = **$525** (the $100 grain and −$75 homemade-feed value were my *example* numbers, not user data; real user data only: 150+250+100 = **$500**) |
| Recorded May costs and Boris's April vet bill in the **"January"** column | sloppy | use the actual months (May; Boris = April) |
| Nanny vet visit = "TBD" row | ok | — |
| Sydney Opera House "inspired by ships"; Burj Khalifa as Modernist; Wright/Sullivan as European 19th-c. | dubious | Opera House shells are usually tied to sails/orange segments; be accurate if asked |
| Sagrada Família "tallest church" when done; projected 2026 | partly uncertain | — |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **LA rock venues**: Whisky a Go Go, Roxy, Greek Theatre, Wiltern, Troubadour, The Forum, Viper Room, Fonda Theatre.
- **LA guitar shops**: Guitar Center Hollywood, Norman's Rare Guitars (Tarzana), Westwood Music, Sam Ash, McCabe's (Santa Monica), "Vintage Gear" (Burbank), "The Music Zoo" (West LA) — the last two are doubtful [assumed].
- **Playlist**: chronological structure; transitions suggested: Bad Guy → Lana's "Ride"; Give It Away → Foo Fighters "The Pretender"; The 1975 "Girls" → "When the Party's Over". Name ideas: Electric Memories, Concert Road Trip, Live and Loud, Tour Favorites, On the Road Again.
- **Great Wall sections**: Badaling (43 mi), Mutianyu (55 mi), Jinshanling (81 mi), Simatai (77 mi) from Beijing.
- **Farm budget template**: Income / Fixed / Variable / Capital / Depreciation / Totals; homemade-feed rows "Grain for Homemade Feed" and "Value of Homemade Feed" (negative).
- **Chicken breeds**: Leghorn 280–300 white eggs/yr, 4–5 lb; Rhode Island Red 200–220 brown/yr, 6–7 lb, docile, cold-hardy, dual-purpose — recommended RIR as suitable for small farm.
- **Cheese/yogurt resources**: Cheesemaking.com, Cheese School of SF, Cultures for Health; books (Asher's *The Art of Natural Cheesemaking*; others I named may be inaccurate); check local dairy regs, HACCP.
- **Feed**: NRC poultry guidelines, extension office (I also named Purdue/Illinois "calculators" — unverified [assumed]); nutrients: protein, calcium, phosphorus, vitamins, grains/fiber.
- **Cherokee**: list of 10 dishes; recipes for Three Sisters Soup (1 c each dried corn, beans, squash; 4 c broth + 2 c water; simmer 1 h) and fritters (flour 1 c, cornmeal ½ c, buttermilk ½ c). Canned corn/beans OK: one 15-oz can each, ~30 min. Oil **350–375°F**. (Some dishes on my list, e.g. "Bannock", "Sobahegwa", are questionable as Cherokee.)
- **KDP final prompt**: "I want you to act as a comprehensive publisher for low-content books on Amazon KDP… creating and providing the content… every aspect… from content creation to the final publishing stage."
- **Detergents**: Seventh Generation, Tide Free & Gentle, Arm & Hammer Plus OxiClean, Method, Ecover.
- **Quinoa recipes**: Roasted Veggie bowl, Quinoa & Black Bean Salad, stuffed peppers, grilled chicken bowl, breakfast bowl. **Classic Tahini Sauce**: ½ c tahini, ¼ c lemon juice, 2 garlic cloves, ¼ c water, salt/pepper.
- **ACS sectors**: pharma, energy, advanced materials, agriculture, biotech.

question: How much have I made from selling eggs this month?
answer:
You've made about **$120** from eggs this month. You'd sold 40 dozen as of May 22, and you sell them to your neighbor at $3 a dozen (40 × $3 = $120).

If you've sold more since May 22, add $3 for each extra dozen.
